data.ruling: The refutation stands. The P2 figure lists "the V112 transient" as not found. P2's own V112 entry also says "No page states a transient or its duration: not read". The checkout P2 read (Research.md@68adf31) does state that transient, so the claim is false. P2 should have recorded it as found and used it in the Servo supply requirement "Highest steady VIN". That requirement currently reads "20 V; transient not stated (V112)". It should give two things. First, the bus transient: 35.7 V to 37.3 V for 3.98 us typical and 5.4 us maximum, plus the gate-discharge time. Second, the owner's answer to V308: a second clamp holds the TPS55285 VIN pins at or under 27 V. Two parts of the transient remain not stated on the page. The gate-discharge part of the duration is one. The second clamp's actual clamping voltage is the other, because a P2-P4 follow-up of R5 and R7 still has to research that clamp. A note on that unstated remainder would be correct. The blanket "not found" is not. One refuted entry is enough for the figure to fail, so I did not rule on the list's other entries, which the verifier says hold. Scope is function: the finding concerns the requirement values of the R6 Servo supply function, not a part's lifecycle, allowlist or LCSC identity.
data.evidence:
Research.md@68adf31bf1c74e2a2c1f32ba925b462a9696115f, read 2026-10-02T22:27:45Z to 22:28:26Z:
- Line 825, V112 (R6, Servo supply), Answer "for research (owner, 2026-09-28)". The question asks for the highest VIN at the servo converter, steady and as a transient with its duration.
- Line 1021, V308, in the Raised by P1 table (columns ID | Category and function | Question | Answer (owner, date)). The text reads: "TVS2701DRBR clamps the inputs at 35.7 V (27 °C) to 37.3 V (125 °C). Until the overvoltage cut-off, 3.98 µs typical and 5.4 µs maximum plus the MOSFETs' gate discharge, the bus carries that voltage to the four TPS55285 (27 V absolute maximum)". The answer reads: "A second clamp on the bus behind the cut-off, ahead of the TPS55285, holds their input pins at or under 27 V ... (owner, 2026-10-02)".
- Line 591, the "input transient clamp" row under Round 2 > Follow-ups, gives the same figures: "the bus sees the clamp voltage for 3.98 µs typical, 5.4 µs maximum, plus the MOSFETs' gate-discharge time, against the TPS55285's 27 V absolute maximum".

The P2 report is /home/claude/rcbench-research/round2/scratch/FU-2H/P2-R6/out/final.json. Its V112 entry reads: "20 V steady ... No page states a transient or its duration: not read". Its Servo supply requirement "Highest steady VIN" reads "20 V; transient not stated (V112)". Its figure "Values not found" lists "the V112 transient".

TPS55285 datasheet SLVSI72A (REVISED OCTOBER 2025), read 2026-10-02T22:28:45Z:
- 5.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings: VIN and SW1 at -0.3 V to 27 V.
- VVIN_OVP rising threshold: 22 V min, 22.5 V typ, 23 V max; hysteresis 0.9 V.
The bus transient of up to 37.3 V on the page is therefore above this part's VIN rating unless the second clamp holds it.

Not stated on the page: the gate-discharge time and the second clamp's clamping voltage.
